notes.zh:
新增高斯泼溅查看与基础修订、点云创作与修订工作台。
共享漫游与相机旋转设置，支持手机触控。
App 新增两个工具的本地项目快照、返回保存与分享导出；.bwvproject 可在电脑网页、手机网页和 App 间转移。
本次升级原生接口至 6，需要安装新版 APK；已有项目保留。Android 仍为 Preview。
notes.en:
Gaussian splat viewing/editing and the point cloud creation/refinement studio.
Shared fly/orbit navigation with mobile touch controls.
Native editor snapshots, save-aware Back and share/export; transfer .bwvproject files between desktop web, mobile web and Android.
Native API 6 requires the new APK. Existing projects are retained. Android remains Preview.
